name: enablement
description:
Filter the results by enablement.

Enablement is a customer setting that stops Port OS from using a resource
without deleting it. Port OS uses it in place of deletion because it cannot
delete a device on the provider's side.

Defaults to ENABLED. Use DISABLED to list only disabled resources, or '*' to
include both enabled and disabled resources.

Looking up a resource by its exact id ignores this filter.
